Package net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client

package net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client
Connects text formatting to native font geometry, bidi shaping and local client reloads.

OpenGL helpers require the client render thread and its current context. Their nested scopes restore the caller's state after normal and exceptional draw exits. The configuration proxy reads only local presentation preferences; common/server startup does not instantiate it.
